title: Can You Use Night Cream Under Your Eyes? What to Check First
ex: A plain night cream is usually fine under the eyes in a tiny amount. Creams with kojic acid, retinol or acids need more care. Here is how to decide.
rt: Can You Use Night Cream Under Your Eyes? | Mirc Glow
rd: Can you use night cream under your eyes? Often yes, in a tiny amount. Which creams to keep away, how to apply it, and when you need a separate eye cream.
keyword: can you use night cream under your eyes
quick: Often, yes. A plain, fragrance-free night cream is usually fine under the eyes if you tap a rice-grain amount onto the orbital bone with your ring finger. Use creams with kojic acid only on the outer eye area at first, keep retinol and acids away, and never apply cream on the eyelids.
facts: Under-eye skin is very thin with few oil glands
A rice-grain amount covers both eyes
Heavy creams can cause milia and morning puffiness
Cream will not change dark circles from genetics or bone structure
